findings.title: Manual close and watcher use separate execution claims
findings.repro: Create manual-close-claimed.json as CLI standalone close does, then call watch on the same prepared plan at expiry: watch-claimed.json is also created and closer runs once again. Concurrent manual close and arm/watch can therefore both invoke SQL/runtime closure.
findings.impact: Violates promised single close attempt and can repeat management mutation/restore after an uncertain first outcome; underlying exact SQL and runtime lock/idempotency limit damage but do not enforce no retry.
findings.fix: Use one shared exclusive execution claim immediately before any non-recovery closer, across manual and watcher. Registration/heartbeat can remain separate. Loser must not invoke closure; read-only reconciliation remains explicit. Add both interleaving regressions.

confirmed: Exact complete Source/Provider scope + role/window guards precede mutation. Foreign scopes/role expiry stop and independent SQL readback is required.
SQL UNKNOWN is read back without SQL retry; runtime restore is withheld until SQL closure is independently verified.
Same-image runtime baseline fingerprints preserve supplied Trip/P1 env/mounts and other gates; Compose UNKNOWN is inspected without up retry.
Private run/plan/helper hashes and exact finite runtime paths checked; defaults prepare only.
Detached process survives parent termination and closes actual isolated PG at expiry; no remote runtime evidence claimed.
remaining: Close race must be fixed before single-attempt watchdog qualification.
Actual C3/Actor/Reader/Provider scope and live service/mount preimages still must be populated under approved Gate.
No DEV/Provider/Native or actual remote restoration was executed.
